memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: New onset, GAD-7 to be checked, patient reports worry, restlessness, mild insomnia.
  - Plan: Start escitalopram 5 mg OD after breakfast, buspirone 5 mg BD with meals; order TSH, haemoglobin, GAD-7; advise balanced diet: breakfast - whole grain toast with egg, lunch - dal‑rice with vegetables, dinner - light soup and salad; weight 68 kg, waist 88 cm (<90 cm cut‑off); review in 8 weeks.
- Due: No glucose‑lowering therapy; HbA1c not required.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: Improved, GAD-7 6, reports less worry, better sleep; mild gastrointestinal upset with buspirone.
  - Plan: Continue escitalopram 5 mg OD after breakfast; reduce buspirone to 2.5 mg BD with meals to ease GI upset; repeat TSH and haemoglobin in 3 months; diet advice: breakfast - oats with fruit, lunch - chapati‑dal‑vegetable, dinner - khichdi with curd; weight 67.5 kg, waist 86 cm (<90 cm).
- Due: No glucose‑lowering therapy; HbA1c not required.

- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: Stable, GAD-7 4, occasional mild dizziness on buspirone.
  - Plan: Hold buspirone for 2 weeks to assess dizziness; continue escitalopram 5 mg OD after breakfast; if dizziness resolves, restart buspirone 2.5 mg BD; repeat TSH and haemoglobin in 3 months; diet advice: breakfast - idli with sambar, lunch - rice‑rasam‑vegetable, dinner - roti‑curd; weight 67 kg, waist 85 cm (<90 cm).
- Due: No glucose‑lowering therapy; HbA1c not required.

- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: Anxiety worsened after stopping buspirone, GAD-7 8, reports tension and irritability.
  - Plan: Restart buspirone 5 mg BD with meals; continue escitalopram 5 mg OD after breakfast; add brief relaxation counseling; repeat TSH and haemoglobin in 3 months; diet advice: breakfast - poha with peanuts, lunch - bisi bele bath with curd, dinner - vegetable pulao; weight 68 kg, waist 87 cm (<90 cm).
- Due: No glucose‑lowering therapy; HbA1c not required.
